notes.hook: The on-screen text '31 MONTHS OF SILENCE' provides a strong curiosity gap for the first two seconds.
notes.clarity: The chronological structure makes a decade-long mission very easy to understand in under a minute.
notes.payoff: The 'Hello, world!' moment provides a high-quality emotional peak to the technical story.
notes.visuals: Most images are accurate, but the solar arrays in beat 5 belong to the ISS, not Rosetta.
notes.loop: The narration ends on a low-energy landing speed that flows naturally back into the start of the script.

frames.problem: shows the International Space Station solar arrays rather than Rosetta's unique twin-panel design
